source_proofs.support: RANDOPEN saves previous EX/S2 through EXSWAP. RANDBACK restores them on missing-extent read 4 or directory-full write 5; RC and allocation map still describe that extent.
ZEROLOOP calls BIOWRS then DMABACK for every zero-fill record.
DMABACK restores CURDMA through BIODMA before interpreting the saved BIOS result and entering BADSECT.
Function 45 stores E in ERRMODE and returns zero. It sets policy rather than performing or returning the transfer.
BADSECT/BDERR apply the selected error mode; FE/FF return the transfer error to the program.
Function 28 sets the default-drive ROVEC bit. Its API number can be deferred without losing operator protection meaning.
Reset clears temporary ROVEC state and logs the selected drive; descriptor protection is a separate volume property.
DIR computes at least one name per row from width divided by 13; names pad to 12 with a separating space, except the last has no padding.
REMOVE changes a requested UC1 console to CRT when the ROM PICO record exists, then drops the UC1 hook.
Returned carry branches directly to BIOS-target scan. No REMOVE on ordinary failed INIT. Clean scan restores ceiling and sweeps claimed slots; hooked pages have a different retained-page path.
Typed failed SVC installation reaches BADCMD except the expressly bounded startup absent-device case.
